Accept the CardIf you choose to accept the Card, the information we provide to the credit bureau(s) may impact your credit score.More fromFrequently Asked Questions about the Blue Cash Everyday® CardWhat is the annual fee for the American Express Blue Cash Everyday® Card?The American Express Blue Cash Everyday® Card has no annual fee.¤†What are the benefits of the American Express Blue Cash Everyday® Card?
With the American Express Blue Cash Everyday® Card, you can earn:
3% cash back on purchases at U.S. supermarkets, on up to $6,000 per year in purchases (then 1%).‡
3% cash back on U.S. online retail purchases, on up to $6,000 per year in purchases (then1%).‡
3% cash back on gas purchases at U.S. gas stations on up to $6,000 per year in purchases (then 1%).‡
1% cash back on other eligible purchases.‡
Cash Back is received as Reward Dollars that can be redeemed for a statement credit or for other select options.‡The American Express Blue Cash Everyday® Card also offers a suite of benefits such as, but not limited to:
Disney Streaming Credit: With the $84 Disney Streaming Credit, you can earn up to $7 back per month as a statement credit when you use your enrolled Blue Cash Everyday® Card to purchase a subscription, including a bundle subscription, on DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com, or Stream.ESPN.com U.S. websites, with no minimum purchase requirement. Subscription is subject to auto-renewal.‡
Help meet your savings goals faster: Turn everyday purchases into future savings. Whether you're stocking up on groceries, filling up your tank, or shopping online, eligible everyday purchases can help you earn Reward Dollars. Redeem Reward Dollars for a deposit into an American Express® High Yield Savings Account.‡ Deposit accounts offered by American Express National Bank. Member FDIC.
Using Cash Back* at Amazon.com checkout: Make the most of Reward Dollars by using them to cover all or part or your everyday purchases at Amazon.com. When checking out with your linked Blue Cash Everyday® Card, apply Reward Dollars toward millions of eligible items.‡*Cash Back refers to Reward Dollars earned on your Card.
Amex Special Ticket Access: Card Members have access to purchase Amex Presale Tickets®‡ and Amex Reserved Tickets®‡ to select can’t-miss events and moments across sports, music, and more.****While supplies last, not all seats may be offered.
What is the difference between the Blue Cash Everyday® Card and the Blue Cash Preferred® Card?The main difference between the Blue Cash Everyday® Card and the Blue Cash Preferred® Card is the rewards structure and the annual fee.The Blue Cash Everyday® Card offers 3% cash back at U.S. supermarkets‡, 3% Cash Back on Gas at U.S. Gas Stations‡, and 3% cash back on U.S. online retail purchases‡ for each category on up to $6,000 per year in purchases (then 1%) with no annual fee.¤† The Blue Cash Everyday® Card is a great option depending on your top spending categories.Is the American Express Blue Cash Everyday® Card good for everyday spending?The American Express Blue Cash Everyday® Card may be an excellent choice for daily spending, with 3% cash back at U.S. supermarkets‡, 3% cash back on gas at U.S. gas stations‡, and 3% cash back on U.S. online retail purchases‡, for each category on up to $6,000 per year in purchases (then 1%). The Blue Cash Everyday® Card could make your everyday spending more rewarding.Are there any fees for using the American Express Blue Cash Everyday® Card abroad?
